description.name: Entry
description.text: Activates Lightning Chain (max 150, field +50%), grants [Buff Lightning 10% (5s)]/[Buff Lightning 20% (5s)]/[Buff Lightning 30% (5s)] if 0-1/2-3/4+ allies have any [Attach Lightning], grants [ATK +50% (25s)], grants [Instant Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Buff Lightning 10% (5s)
description.text: Increases Lightning damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Lightning 20% (5s)
description.text: Increases Lightning damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Lightning 30% (5s)
description.text: Increases Lightning damage dealt by 30%, cumulable

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%
